{{Short description|Type of mathematical category}}
In [[category theory]], a branch of [[mathematics]], the '''permutation category'''<ref>{{harvnb|Trimble|n.d.|loc=§ 1}}</ref> is the [[category (mathematics)|category]] where
#the objects are the natural numbers,
#the morphisms from a natural number ''n'' to itself are the elements of the [[symmetric group]] <math>S_n</math> and
#there are no morphisms from ''m'' to ''n'' if <math>m\neq n</math>.

It is [[equivalence of categories|equivalent as a category]] to the category of finite sets and bijections between them.
